{{short description|German virologist}}
[[File:Brinkmann Dezember 2020 in weiss.jpg|thumb|upright=1.3|{{center|Melanie Brinkmann (2020)}}]]
'''Melanie Brinkmann''' is a German [[Virology|virologist]].  Until 2019 she was probably best known in connection with her work on the [[Cytomegalovirus]]. During 2020 she emerged as a much consulted expert-pundit for media commentators keen to discuss the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].   Brinkmann took a robust public position in the campaign against [[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic misinformation]]:  she described the so-called "virus of false information" as "more deadly than the [COVID-19] virus itself".<ref name=MBvolgensKochStichting>{{cite web|url= https://www.robert-koch-stiftung.de/index.php?article_id=53&clang=0 |title=Melanie M. Brinkmann|work=Preis für Postdoktorandinnen und Postdoktoranden für Virologie 2007 (Ckick on "Laudatio" and "Lebenslauf"|publisher=[[:de:Robert-Koch-Stiftung|Robert-Koch-Stiftung e.V.]], Berlin|accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref><ref name= MBlautTUB01>{{cite web|title= Antrittsvorlesung von Prof. Dr. Melanie M. Brinkmann .... zur Person |url= https://magazin.tu-braunschweig.de/pi-post/antrittsvorlesung-von-prof-dr-melanie-m-brinkmann/|publisher=[[Technical University of Braunschweig|Technische Universität Braunschweig]] |work=Die faszinierende Welt der Viren |accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref><ref name= MBGegnerinFalschinformation>{{cite web |title=Gegen das Virus der Falschinformation |url= https://www.tagesschau.de/investigativ/swr/wissenschaftler-gegen-falschnachrichten-101.html|date=7 May 2020 |work=Ärzte und Virologen .... "Tödlicher als das Virus selber"|author=Marcel Kolvenbach |publisher= Norddeutscher Rundfunk, Hamburg |accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref><ref name=MBHlautHZI>{{cite web |title= Viral Immune Modulation .... Prof Dr Melanie Brinkmann |publisher= Helmholtz-Zentrum für Infektionsforschung GmbH, Braunschweig |url=https://www.helmholtz-hzi.de/en/research/research-topics/immune-response/viral-immune-modulation/m-brinkmann |accessdate= 19 December 2020}}</ref><ref name=MBiGmJK>{{cite web |url= https://www.spiegel.de/wissenschaft/medizin/corona-expertin-melanie-brinkmann-keine-immunitaet-in-einem-sommer-a-612e49dc-0e2b-46f6-8183-7e88b9f9e065|date=15 June 2020|title="Im Laufe eines Sommers wird das nicht klappen" |work=Viele hoffen darauf, dass die Lockerungen der Corona-Maßnahmen zu mehr Immunität gegen das Virus führen. Die Virologin Melanie Brinkmann dämpft die Hoffnungen. |author=Janne Kieselbach |publisher= [[Der Spiegel]] (online) |accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Melanie Margarete Brinkmann was born at [[Neustadt am Rübenberge]], a town [[Hanover Region|near Hanover]], and attended school in nearby [[Garbsen]]. In 1993 she enrolled at the [[University of Hanover]] where for a year she studied [[English studies|Anglistics]] and [[Sociology]]. In 1994 she transferred to [[University of Göttingen|Göttingen]], emerging two years later with a first degree in [[Biology]].<ref name=MBvolgensKochStichting>{{cite web|url= https://www.robert-koch-stiftung.de/index.php?article_id=53&clang=0 |title=Melanie M. Brinkmann|work=Preis für Postdoktorandinnen und Postdoktoranden für Virologie 2007 (Ckick on "Laudatio" and "Lebenslauf"|publisher=[[:de:Robert-Koch-Stiftung|Robert-Koch-Stiftung e.V.]], Berlin|accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref> Following a formal 'very good' ({{lang|de|sehr gut}}) commendation in recognition of her exam grades Brinkmann moved on again, this time to [[Humboldt University of Berlin|Berlin]], still studying biology.<ref name=MBHlautHZI/> However, it was from the [[University of Hanover]] that in 2004 she received her doctorate, for which she was supervised by Thomas F. Schulz. Her dissertation concerned the "Functional properties of proteins encoded by the K15 gene of the Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus".<ref name=MBpromocerte>{{cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/35417407 |title=Functional properties of proteins encoded by the K15 gene of the Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV)  |author=Melanie Brinkmann |date=2004 |work=To read the full-text of this research, you can request a copy directly from the author. |accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref><ref name= MBlautTUB02>{{cite web|url=https://magazin.tu-braunschweig.de/event/antrittsvorlesung-von-prof-dr-melanie-brinkmann/
|title=Antrittsvorlesung "Die faszinierende Welt der Viren" |work=Melanie Brinkmann studierte Biologie in Göttingen ... (biographical note on Melanie Brinkmann in connection with a public lecture she delivered in 2019)|publisher=Technische Universität Braunschweig|date=6 November 2019|accessdate=19 December 2020}}</ref> As well as the doctorate, this work earned her a "summa cum laude" commendation<ref name=MBvolgensKochStichting/> and the doctorates prize awarded by the [[Hannover Medical School]].<ref name=MBHlautHZI/>   In 2007 she received a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral research prize]] for [[Virology]] from the [[Berlin]]-based [[:de:Robert-Koch-Stiftung|Robert Koch Foundation]].<ref name= MBvolgensKochStichting/>

== Career==
Supported by a research grant from the [[Bonn]]-based [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft|DFG]], between 2006 and 2010 Brinkmann worked as a [[postdoctoral researcher]] with [[Hidde Ploegh]] at the [[Whitehead Institute|Whitehead Institute for Biomedical Research]] in [[Cambridge, Massachusetts]].<ref name=MBvolgensKochStichting/> Her research focus was on [[Toll-like receptor|Toll-like receptors (TLRs)]].<ref name= MBlautTUB02/>

In July 2010 Brinkmann took on the leadership of the "[[Immunotherapy]] Successor Group" (''"Nachwuchsgruppe: Virale Immunmodulation"'') at the [[Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research (HZI)]] in [[Braunschweig]]. She has since been involved in several [[virology]] and [[immunology]] research projects backed by the [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft|DFG]].<ref name=ProjekteMBlautDFG>{{cite web |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/gepris/person/21889682?context=person&task=showDetail&id=21889682& |title=Detailseite: Professorin Dr. Melanie Brinkmann |work=click on [Projekte] |publisher= Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Bonn |accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref> The work she undertook between 2005 and 2008 in [[Massachusetts]] on [[Toll-like receptor|TLRs]] was one of these: the project had as its objective the investigation of [[Herpesvirales]] [[:de:Immunevasion|immune escape]].<ref name=TLRsuImmun-Evasion>{{cite web |title=Detailseite: Toll-like Rezeptoren: Ziele der herpesviralen Immun-Evasion? / Goals of Herpes Virus Immune Evasion? |work=Herpesviren etablieren lebenslange, persistierende Infektionen und haben während Jahrzehntausenden der Koevolution mit ihren Wirten Mechanismen hervorgebracht, um der Eliminierung durch das Wirtsimmunsystem zu entgehen. Für die Existenz von Strategien der Herpesviren, die durch Toll-like Rezeptoren (TLRs)-vermittelte angeborene Immunantwort zu modulieren, gibt es folgende Indizien ..... |date=2008 |publisher= Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Bonn  |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/gepris/projekt/21889724 |accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref> Since 2010 she has been co-leader of the  [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft|DFG]] project on Modulation of the Immune Response through the [[Gammaherpesvirinae]]-linked [[Kaposi's sarcoma]], associated with the [[Herpesviridae]] and the Murines Herpesvirus 68 (BO3).<ref name=TumorvirusKaposiSarko>{{cite web |title=Detailseite: Modulation der Immunantwort durch die Gammaherpesviren Kaposi Sarkom-assoziiertes Herpesvirus und Murines Herpesvirus 68 (B03)  |work=Das Tumorvirus Kaposi Sarkom-assoziiertes Herpesvirus (KSHV) ist die Ursache zahlreicher Krankheiten, unter anderem des Kaposi Sarkoms (KS), der häufigsten Krebsart bei HIV-infizierten Individuen. Die Infektion mit KSHV wird vom Immunsystem erkannt, jedoch ..... |date=2008 |publisher= Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Bonn  |url=https://gepris.dfg.de/gepris/projekt/178929289?context=projekt&task=showDetail&id=178929289&|accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref>

Since 2018 Brinkmann has held a [[:de:Besoldungsordnung W|Level W2]] professorship in Virus Genetics at the [[Genetics |Genetics Institute]] of the [[Technical University of Braunschweig|"Technical University of Braunschweig" (TUB)]],<ref name=PersonaliabijTUB>{{cite web|title= .... rof. Dr. rer. nat. Melanie M. Brinkmann – W2 - Professorin an der TU Braunschweig |url=https://www.helmholtz.de/aktuell/presse-und-medien/newsletter/helmholtz-netzwerk/helmholtz-netzwerk-022018/personalia/ |work=Personalia  |publisher=[[Technical University of Braunschweig|Technische Universität Braunschweig]] |accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref> in which she oversees the "Infections and Active Elements" (''"Infektionen und Wirkstoffe"'') research speciality.<ref name= MBlautTUB02/>

=== Media profile ===
During the spread of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany|COVID-19 pandemic]] Brinkmann became a frequent media presence, principally in Germany. In May 2020 she was co-organiser and a co-signatory, with [[Christian Drosten]] of the [[Charité]], of an open letter from 100 doctors, nurses and health experts calling for stronger action to be taken by providers of media platforms/services against [[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic misinformation]].<ref name=100Aerzten01>{{cite web|title=Offener Brief - Ärzte bekämpfen Fake-News |work=Tausende Menschen bekommen täglich falsche Informationen rund um das Coronavirus zu sehen. Nun wenden sich Ärzte und Experten, darunter Melanie Brinkmann und Christian Drosten, in einem offenen Brief an die Betreiber der Plattformen. Sie fordern zwei Schritte.|date=11 May 2020|url=https://www.mittellaendische.ch/2020/05/11/offener-brief-%C3%A4rzte-bek%C3%A4mpfen-fake-news/#gsc.tab=0|publisher=Die Mittelländische Zeitung (online) FR|accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref><ref name=100Aerzten02>{{cite web|url=https://www.spiegel.de/netzwelt/netzpolitik/corona-personalmangel-bei-facebook-und-youtube-im-kampf-gegen-falschinformationen-a-6ee64a69-afec-428a-976f-8706de53b2c6 |title=Personalmangel erschwert Kampf gegen Corona-Falschinformationen|work=Die großen Netzwerke werden mit falschen und teils gefährlichen Corona-Inhalten geflutet. Doch die Plattformen haben ein Problem: Ihre Moderatoren sind im Homeoffice und arbeiten nur eingeschränkt.|author=[[Marcel Rosenbach]]|date=8 May 2020|publisher=[[Der Spiegel]] (online)|accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref> Billed, by this time, as "Germany's best known virologist", she shared these concerns in a television interview on 7 May 2020, insisting on the importance to virologists that infected people should not use [[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic|false information]] as the basis for decisions that could imperil their lives or the lives of others:  "We must ensure that information that has not yet been adequately evaluated by experts does not become widely disseminated".<ref name= MBGegnerinFalschinformation/>

== Recognition ==
{{Commons category}}
In 2016 Brinkmann received the Science Award - donated by Biomol GmbH of [[Hamburg]] - from the [[Hanover]]-based [[Signal transduction]] Society.<ref name=MBalsPreistraegerin>{{cite web |url=https://sigtrans.de/downloads/STS-Science-Award%20-%20List%20of%20Awardees.pdf|title= STS-Science Awards |work=The murine cytomegalovirus protein M35 is a novel negative regulator of the type I interferon response. |publisher=Gesellschaft für Signaltransduktion e.V., Medical School Hannover |accessdate=21 December 2020}}</ref>
